name: Modern Data Analytics in Materials Science
description: Mathematical foundations including vectors, matrices, and statistics. Data preprocessing, feature engineering, and dimensionality reduction techniques (PCA, t-SNE). Unsupervised learning methods like clustering for microstructure analysis. Supervised learning algorithms including regression and classification for structure–property prediction. Model evaluation, interpretability (for example, SHAP), and uncertainty quantification. Applications in materials discovery and performance modeling using experimental and computational data. Practical/practice activities include weekly python-based exercises using libraries like pandas, numpy, matplotlib, and scikit-learn. Hands-on analysis of real materials datasets, development of machine learning pipelines, and a final project focusing on reviewing a materials engineering problem solved using data analytics.
